items.name: Rezera (RZRA)

note.de: Bostoner Entzündungs-Biotech (früher NodThera); 16,7 Mio. Aktien zu 11–13 USD (ca. 200 Mio. USD), GSK zeigt Interesse an bis zu 25 Mio. USD. Erster Handelstag laut IPOScoop heute; ein Ausgabepreis war bei Redaktionsschluss noch nicht gemeldet.
note.bg: Биотехнологична компания от Бостън за възпалителни заболявания (бивша NodThera); 16,7 млн. акции по 11–13 USD (около 200 млн. USD), GSK проявява интерес до 25 млн. USD. Според IPOScoop търговията започва днес; към момента на публикуване цена още не е обявена.
note.en: Boston inflammation biotech (formerly NodThera); 16.7m shares at USD 11–13 (about USD 200m), with GSK indicating interest in up to USD 25m. IPOScoop lists today as the first trading day; no offer price had been reported at the time of writing.
note.es: Biotecnológica de Boston contra la inflamación (antes NodThera); 16,7 millones de acciones a 11–13 USD (unos 200 millones de USD); GSK ha mostrado interés por hasta 25 millones. Según IPOScoop debuta hoy; al cierre de esta edición aún no se había comunicado el precio.
note.tr: Bostonlu iltihap biyoteknoloji şirketi (eski adı NodThera); 11–13 USD'den 16,7 milyon hisse (yaklaşık 200 milyon USD), GSK 25 milyon USD'ye kadar ilgi gösterdi. IPOScoop'a göre ilk işlem günü bugün; yayın saatinde henüz fiyat açıklanmamıştı.

items.name: vVardis (VVVV)

note.de: Schweizer Kariesbehandlung ohne Bohren (Zug); 9,5 Mio. Aktien zu 21–24 USD (ca. 214 Mio. USD). IPOScoop nennt jetzt Freitag, 13.11., als ersten Handelstag. Zuletzt 52,2 Mio. USD Verlust bei 49,7 Mio. USD Umsatz (12 Monate bis Juni).
note.bg: Швейцарско лечение на кариес без пробиване (Цуг); 9,5 млн. акции по 21–24 USD (около 214 млн. USD). IPOScoop вече посочва петък, 13.11., като първи ден на търговия. Загуба 52,2 млн. USD при приходи 49,7 млн. USD (12 месеца до юни).
note.en: Swiss drill-free cavity treatment (Zug); 9.5m shares at USD 21–24 (about USD 214m). IPOScoop now lists Friday, 13 Nov, as the first trading day. Net loss USD 52.2m on revenue of USD 49.7m (12 months to June).
note.es: Tratamiento suizo de caries sin fresa (Zug); 9,5 millones de acciones a 21–24 USD (unos 214 millones de USD). IPOScoop sitúa ahora el debut el viernes 13/11. Pérdida de 52,2 millones de USD con ingresos de 49,7 millones (12 meses a junio).
note.tr: İsviçreli, matkapsız çürük tedavisi (Zug); 21–24 USD'den 9,5 milyon hisse (yaklaşık 214 milyon USD). IPOScoop artık ilk işlem günü olarak 13.11 Cuma'yı gösteriyor. Haziran'a kadar 12 ayda 49,7 milyon USD gelirle 52,2 milyon USD zarar.

items.name: Windward Bio (WWB)

sector.es: Biotecnología (enfermedades respiratorias y de la piel)

note.de: Basler Biotech mit lang wirkenden Antikörpern gegen Asthma, COPD und Neurodermitis; 10,3 Mio. Aktien zu 16–18 USD (ca. 175 Mio. USD), Bewertung knapp 1 Mrd. USD; Sanofi steigt parallel per Privatplatzierung mit 50 Mio. USD ein. 68,2 Mio. USD Verlust (12 Monate bis Juni).
note.bg: Биотехнологична компания от Базел с дълго действащи антитела срещу астма, ХОББ и атопичен дерматит; 10,3 млн. акции по 16–18 USD (около 175 млн. USD), оценка близо 1 млрд. USD; Sanofi влиза паралелно с частно пласиране за 50 млн. USD. Загуба 68,2 млн. USD (12 месеца до юни).
note.en: Basel biotech with long-acting antibodies for asthma, COPD and atopic dermatitis; 10.3m shares at USD 16–18 (about USD 175m), valuation close to USD 1bn; Sanofi to invest USD 50m in a concurrent private placement. Net loss of USD 68.2m (12 months to June).
note.es: Biotecnológica de Basilea con anticuerpos de acción prolongada contra asma, EPOC y dermatitis atópica; 10,3 millones de acciones a 16–18 USD (unos 175 millones de USD), valoración cercana a 1.000 millones; Sanofi invertirá 50 millones en una colocación privada paralela. Pérdida de 68,2 millones de USD (12 meses a junio).
note.tr: Astım, KOAH ve atopik dermatite karşı uzun etkili antikorlar geliştiren Baselli biyoteknoloji şirketi; 16–18 USD'den 10,3 milyon hisse (yaklaşık 175 milyon USD), değerleme 1 milyar USD'ye yakın; Sanofi eş zamanlı özel yerleşimle 50 milyon USD yatıracak. Haziran'a kadar 12 ayda 68,2 milyon USD zarar.

items.name: Primagrove (YHTE)

note.de: Kleiner Börsengang aus Hongkong (Software, smarte Schließfächer und Ruhekabinen fürs Büro); 6,3 Mio. Aktien zu 4–6 USD, laut IPOScoop in der Woche ab 16.11. erwartet.
note.bg: Малко първично предлагане от Хонконг (софтуер, смарт шкафчета и кабини за тиха работа в офиса); 6,3 млн. акции по 4–6 USD, според IPOScoop очаквано в седмицата от 16.11.
note.en: Small Hong Kong IPO (software, smart lockers and silent booths for offices); 6.3m shares at USD 4–6, expected by IPOScoop in the week of 16 Nov.
note.es: OPV pequeña de Hong Kong (software, taquillas inteligentes y cabinas silenciosas para oficinas); 6,3 millones de acciones a 4–6 USD, prevista por IPOScoop la semana del 16/11.
note.tr: Hong Kong'dan küçük halka arz (yazılım, ofisler için akıllı dolap ve sessiz kabinler); 4–6 USD'den 6,3 milyon hisse, IPOScoop'a göre 16.11 haftasında bekleniyor.

items.name: Anthropic (ANT)

note.de: Preisspanne jetzt 70–78 USD für 825 Mio. Aktien (57,75–64,35 Mrd. USD), laut TechCrunch bis 1,404 Bill. USD Bewertung (voll verwässert); Handelsstart um den 19.11. erwartet, endgültiger Preis steht noch aus.
note.bg: Ценовият диапазон вече е 70–78 USD за 825 млн. акции (57,75–64,35 млрд. USD), според TechCrunch оценка до 1,404 трлн. USD (напълно разводнена); търговията се очаква около 19.11., окончателната цена още не е определена.
note.en: Price range now USD 70–78 for 825m shares (USD 57.75–64.35bn), valuing the company at up to USD 1.404tn fully diluted per TechCrunch; trading expected around 19 Nov, final price still pending.
note.es: Rango de precio ahora de 70–78 USD para 825 millones de acciones (57.750–64.350 millones de USD), valoración de hasta 1,404 billones de USD totalmente diluida según TechCrunch; debut previsto hacia el 19/11, precio final pendiente.
note.tr: Fiyat aralığı artık 825 milyon hisse için 70–78 USD (57,75–64,35 milyar USD); TechCrunch'a göre tam seyreltilmiş değerleme 1,404 trilyon USD'ye kadar; işlemlerin 19.11 civarında başlaması bekleniyor, nihai fiyat henüz belli değil.

items.name: American Barrick Gold (ABGC)

note.de: Abspaltung der Nordamerika-Minen von Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); Börsenprospekt am 10.11. eingereicht, Preis und Aktienzahl offen, Renaissance Capital schätzt bis zu 6 Mrd. USD; Start laut Barrick bis Anfang 2027.
note.bg: Отделяне на северноамериканските мини на Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); проспектът е подаден на 10.11., цена и брой акции още няма, Renaissance Capital оценява до 6 млрд. USD; старт според Barrick до началото на 2027 г.
note.en: Carve-out of Barrick Mining's North American mines (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); filed on 10 Nov with price and share count still open, Renaissance Capital estimates up to USD 6bn; launch by early 2027 according to Barrick.
note.es: Escisión de las minas norteamericanas de Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); folleto presentado el 10/11, sin precio ni número de acciones, Renaissance Capital estima hasta 6.000 millones de USD; lanzamiento a principios de 2027 según Barrick.
note.tr: Barrick Mining'in Kuzey Amerika madenlerinin ayrılması (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); izahname 10.11'de sunuldu, fiyat ve hisse sayısı belli değil, Renaissance Capital 6 milyar USD'ye kadar tahmin ediyor; Barrick'e göre başlangıç 2027 başına kadar.
